% Pattern: proof/amsthm/article. A proof written inside its statement, before
% \end{theorem}.
% from 1809.06512
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=theorem-1 parent=theorem-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem}
Each tree is a graph.
\begin{proof}
A tree is a graph with no cycle.
\end{proof}
\end{theorem}
\end{document}
